title: Extend Print Portfolio With Thesis
description: Extend the print portfolio with a full featured thesis document including PhD and other academic degrees; implement and verify using parallel agents.
summary: Implemented full thesis and PhD portfolio support for bachelor, master, doctoral and custom degrees, explicit English/German, light/dark themes, academic metadata and apparatus, schema/TypeScript API, worked manuscript, catalog and build/test integration. Verified 27 composed actual feature scenarios (21 positive rendering probes and six real compiler refusals), 84 declaration/contrast/paint tests with 282 assertions, 14 focused lifecycle/refusal tests with 208 assertions, and strict typing across 2,190 Source files with zero diagnostics. Corrected ordinary canonical build 54764 passed all seven tasks; current-root inspection 16985 passed all four thesis/PhD PDFs including complete hierarchical numeral paint, references and page numbering. All eight fresh cover/body visual reviews passed. Managed private cleanup smoke passed and absence was independently verified; exact ticket-generated directory removed after durable audit/hash preservation, canonical products and authored inputs retained. Shared reader/retirement contributions are narrowly attributed in files.md. Actual runtime validation was Linux; portable native interfaces remain in use.
